purpose: A static claim-to-evidence index for this edition; not a capability registry, authority grant or production admission system.
scope: Internal independent-agent review within the same AI-assisted team, not external independent validation.

taxonomy.observed: Executed artifacts, records or measured software outputs within the stated scope.
taxonomy.sourced: A fact attributed to a supplied primary source; cited scope/date qualifications remain relevant.
taxonomy.assumed: A declared scenario or contract input without empirical validation in this study.
taxonomy.calibrated: An estimate anchored to observations; no empirical performance gain is labeled calibrated in this edition.
taxonomy.derived: A mathematical consequence of stated assumptions or records, not a measured benefit.
taxonomy.simulated: An outcome of the executable conditional economic model.
taxonomy.unknown: A quantity intentionally left unknown rather than filled with zero or a scenario estimate.

claims.statement: The frozen executable is byte-identical to the module recovered through the existing research lifecycle.
claims.claim_boundary: This establishes artifact identity and local retrieval; it does not establish live identity authentication or production admission.

claims.statement: The recovered executable passes 48 of 48 compatible held affine missions in separate Python processes.
claims.claim_boundary: Acceptance is the frozen geometric research contract, not customer sign-off or biological validity.

claims.statement: The strong conventional analytical workflow passes the same 48 of 48 compatible missions.
claims.claim_boundary: The baseline may use the same established formulation and cache native summaries; no newly feasible service over this baseline is demonstrated.

claims.statement: An ordinary directory with identical executable contents and permissions matches all 48 scientific outputs exactly, excluding recorded elapsed time.
claims.claim_boundary: No performance premium attributable to graph or lifecycle storage is demonstrated.

claims.statement: All 12 held incompatible or malformed missions receive reasoned HOLD or REJECT results.
claims.claim_boundary: These are declared contract checks. They do not detect a valid matrix whose caller secretly intended a different scientific meaning.

claims.statement: Confirmation comprises two supplied label groups from one image/timepoint, each evaluated on 24 authored affine maps.
claims.claim_boundary: The 48 missions are not 48 independent biological specimens or a population estimate.

claims.statement: Maximum recovered discrepancies are 4.396369261710247e-16 relative measure and 1.0736300737335114e-11 micrometers absolute centroid.
claims.claim_boundary: These compare numerical implementations of declared geometry, not physical measurement accuracy.

claims.statement: The recorded conventional cached numerical workload takes about 0.333 seconds, while recovered invocations total 11.542 seconds externally and 2.200 seconds within numerical measurement.
claims.claim_boundary: Different timing boundaries and process overheads prevent a matched latency-efficiency claim. No speed advantage is attributed to the retained instrument.

claims.statement: Development accepted 61 supplied IDR0062 label regions; four touch the source-array boundary.
claims.claim_boundary: Supplied labels are not independently validated biological cells, and boundary-touching support is not certified complete.

claims.statement: A named nearest-neighbor target-raster diagnostic produces volume errors exceeding 1 percent in 6, 26 and 51 of 61 labels at 0.75, 1.5 and 3 micrometer target spacing.
claims.claim_boundary: This specific diagnostic is not the U configuration, the ceiling of raster methods, or a frontier intelligence limitation.

claims.statement: Hosted U, E and E+ workers each pass all 12 small authored tasks: eight numerical deliveries and four appropriate refusals.
claims.claim_boundary: One worker per arm, same inherited runtime and tool/time ceilings; no randomized population trial or matched token/compute spending. E versus U and E+ versus E each show zero accepted-outcome increment on this sample.

claims.statement: The retained expert workflow and extra executable do not improve accepted quality in the hosted trial.
claims.claim_boundary: A tiny ceiling-performing suite cannot establish absence of benefits on harder work; complete cost and comparable latency advantages remain unmeasured.

claims.statement: All 32 local lifecycle, trust, signature, encryption and accounting conformance controls pass with 29 unchanged upstream dependency files.
claims.claim_boundary: Identities and positive monetary/admission evidence are labeled fixtures. This is neither live ENS nor current authorized network admission.

claims.statement: The unchanged native protected-capsule interface refuses the microscopy scientific scope.
claims.claim_boundary: Research lifecycle retrieval and actual local numerical execution do not qualify this scope for production.

claims.statement: Actual customers, collections and paid API calls are zero in this study.
claims.claim_boundary: Hosted AI workers and authoring did run; zero paid API calls does not mean zero model work or zero underlying cost.

claims.statement: Complete actual research cost, actual operating profit, and complete available operating funds are unknown.
claims.claim_boundary: Unknown obligations and unmetered authoring/model work are not zero. Scenario numbers must not fill these actual-ledger fields.

claims.statement: Full hosted-trial token counts, attributable billing and comparable whole-trial latency are unavailable.
claims.claim_boundary: U alone records a whole-trial wall clock. Same tool/time ceilings do not establish matched complete costs.

claims.statement: OME-NGFF specifies physical-coordinate conventions while excluding exact transformed/resampled pixel reproducibility from its format guarantee.
claims.claim_boundary: The opened specification is v0.6; the downloaded label files are v0.4. This does not imply existing experts cannot compute exact declared quantities.

claims.statement: Physical-space image analysis, feature extraction and affine transformation are established capabilities of existing methods.
claims.claim_boundary: No new affine algorithm or autonomous discovery of this mathematics is claimed.

claims.statement: CHUM lists formatted image-analysis rates of 143.50 dollars/hour for businesses and 129.75 dollars/hour for external university/hospital clients.
claims.claim_boundary: CAD is inferred from provider context; task hours and direct scope equivalence are assumptions, not a quotation.

claims.statement: Blin et al. IDR0062 and Walther et al. IDR0052 supply public CC BY 4.0 image/label data.
claims.claim_boundary: Data credit, license, source links and documented singleton/time extraction changes must travel with redistribution.

claims.statement: The commercial originating job pays CAD550, costs CAD310 in A cash and CAD20 in owner opportunity cost, leaving CAD220 economic surplus.
claims.claim_boundary: This fictional accepted initial condition is not an observed sale, paid research, or an estimate of actual study effort.

claims.statement: Buyer values, human-service hours, labor effort, failure/default probabilities, demand, source compatibility and cash obligations are scenario assumptions.
claims.claim_boundary: The individual 57-parameter registry distinguishes sourced rate anchors from assumed scope/workload and derived quantities. No observed customer commitments are supplied.

claims.statement: The buyer choice rule subtracts the full quote from expected delivered value as a conservative maximum-price screen.
claims.claim_boundary: It is not exact risk-neutral expected utility under conditional payments/refunds. Revised behavioral rules require a prospective new edition.

claims.statement: The 24-hour production capacity applies only to fresh delivery, correction and support labor.
claims.claim_boundary: Fixed origin/new construction, coordination, retention and practice require separately provisioned or outsourced capacity; their staffing and lead times are not modeled.

claims.statement: At CAD65/hour avoidable cash labor and CAD75 additional B cost, four realized eligible reuses require 17.3076923077 minutes saved each for break-even.
claims.claim_boundary: A calculated condition, not observed human effort saved. Positive value requires exceeding the break-even amount absent other changes; forecast opportunities or idle salaried capacity do not create cash savings.

claims.statement: The frozen selected established E policy yields mean CAD596.8611458333 economic surplus: CAD220 fictional origin plus CAD376.8611458333 fresh work.
claims.claim_boundary: Conditional pretax modeled contribution over specified scope. Four of 96 primary worlds lose value; Monte Carlo intervals are variation within assumptions.

claims.statement: With zero retained benefit, E+ rejects retention after the CAD5 screen and loses CAD5 relative to E.
claims.claim_boundary: Profitable conditional service operation does not imply useful incremental retention.

claims.statement: Assumed half-hour, one-hour and negative-half-hour reuse scenarios yield E+ minus E means of -21.171875, 32.65625 and -128.828125 CAD.
claims.claim_boundary: These savings are supplied sensitivities, not measurements. Realized eligible demand can fall below the admission forecast.

claims.statement: Primary mean E surplus is CAD596.86 established, CAD356.86 technical-only, CAD566.24 coordination-only and CAD356.24 combined.
claims.claim_boundary: The supplied technical/common-adapter and coordination arrangement does not outperform the competent established route under primary assumptions. It was not autonomously discovered.

claims.statement: All 13,824 histories satisfy cash conservation; E+ and identical ordinary-library histories match exactly.
claims.claim_boundary: This validates internal accounting/parity under the simulation, not actual willingness to pay, causal learning gains or live enterprise performance.

claims.statement: Post-run finite-value and duplicate-ID scorer hardening leaves stored accepted results unchanged; four NaN probes confirm the guard.
claims.claim_boundary: The first evaluator and outputs are preserved. This is a transparent post-run audit, not an entirely precommitted evaluator or a repaired core presented as fresh success.
